corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez construct phrase 'ፈትለ ሣሬት' (spider's web/thread); the 1st-order 'ለ' and 5th-order 'ሬ' (with right-leg loop) are visible on the page.
The printed text reads 'ወነፍስ በሥጋ ለማለት ደገመው' (theological commentary explaining indwelling in soul and body); 'ወነፍስ' was misread as 'ዐንቀስ' due to ink bleed.
In Ge'ez (John 14:21), the verb 'አፍቀረ' takes the imperfect 'ያፈቅረኒ' (4th-order 'ያ'), which is clearly printed.
In Ge'ez (John 14:21), the 1st-person singular imperfect of causative 'አፍቀረ' is 'አፈቅሮ' (with 1st-order 'አ'), matching the printed glyph.
In John 14:21 ('and I will manifest myself to him', translated in L13 as 'ራሴንም እገልጽለታለሁ'), the printed Ge'ez verb is causative 'ወአርእዮ' (1st-order 'አ' and 6th-order 'ር'), not 'ወእሬእዮ'.
The proper name Thaddaeus is printed 'ታዴዎስ' with 5th-order 'ዴ' (ring on the right leg).
The Ge'ez verb has the 3rd-person masculine object suffix '-ኦ' ('ወአውሥኦ', 'answered him', rendered in L24 as 'መለሰለት'), visibly printed with 7th-order 'ኦ'.
